info.description:
Reproducible computational architecture for **algal bloom simulation**, trophic state prediction, and counterfactual planning in lentic water bodies (lakes, lagoons, and reservoirs).

## Authentication

All endpoints except `/health`, `/version`, and `/metrics` require a Bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

Obtain a token pair via `POST /auth/login`. Rotate it before expiry with `POST /auth/refresh`.

## Roles

**System roles** (per account): `admin` > `researcher` > `viewer`.

**Experiment roles** (per experiment): `owner` > `editor` > `viewer`.

## Rate limits

| Endpoint | Limit |
|---|---|
| `POST /auth/register` | 10 / hour / IP |
| `POST /auth/login` | 20 / min; 100 / hour / IP |
| All other endpoints | 200 / min / IP |

Exceeded limits return `429 Too Many Requests`.

## Pagination

All list endpoints return `{ items, total, limit, offset }`. Use `?limit=` (max 200) and `?offset=` to page through results.

post.description:
Execute a **synchronous** single-point inference and store the result. Returns `201 Created` with the result inline — no polling required.

> **Note:** ML inference is currently a stub. Output fields such as `bloom_probability` will be `null` until model implementations are connected.

**Input variables** (all optional individually):

| Variable | Unit | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `TP_ugL` | µg/L | Total phosphorus — primary eutrophication driver |
| `TN_ugL` | µg/L | Total nitrogen — co-limiting nutrient |
| `chlorophyll_a_ugL` | µg/L | Algal biomass proxy |
| `DO_mgL` | mg/L | Dissolved oxygen |
| `pH` | — | Dimensionless |
| `turbidity_NTU` | NTU | Light availability |
| `temperature_C` | °C | Thermal favorability for algal growth |
| `secchi_depth_m` | m | Water transparency (auxiliary) |
| `wind_speed_ms` | m/s | Mixing/stratification (auxiliary) |
| `residence_time_d` | days | Hydraulic retention time (auxiliary) |

**Valid `horizon_days` values:** `30`, `60`, `90`.

| `aeration` | `intensity` [0–1] |
